title: CBDT Streamlines TDS Rules for Non-Resident Immovable Property Transfers
content:
# CBDT Streamlines TDS Rules for Non-Resident Immovable Property Transfers

Ek important update hai! Government ne Non-Resident se Immovable Property Transfer par Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) ke rules mein significant amendments announce kiye hain. Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Income-tax (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026 introduce kiye hain.

Here are the key highlights:

*   **Notification Details:** This update comes via Notification No. 121/2026-Income Tax, dated September 22, 2026.
*   **Effective Date:** These new rules will come into force from October 1, 2026.
*   **TAN Requirement Waived:** Ab resident individuals aur Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs) ko non-resident sellers se immovable property kharidne par TDS deduct karne ke liye Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN) obtain karne ki zaroorat nahin hogi.
*   **New Compliance Mechanism:** TDS ab prescribed PAN-based challan-cum-statement mechanism ke through report aur deposit kiya ja sakega.
*   **Forms Amended:** Rules 215, 218, aur 219 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026 ko amend kiya gaya hai.
*   **New Reporting Schedule:** Form No. 141 mein ek naya Schedule E add kiya gaya hai. Isme property particulars, buyers and non-resident sellers ki details, sale consideration, stamp duty value, payment instalments, capital gains classification, aur TDS deducted ki detailed information provide karni hogi.
*   **Non-Resident Details:** Non-resident sellers ke liye unka overseas address, Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) number, aur foreign tax identification number provide karna mandatory hoga, even if PAN is not available.
